goal: Set how many hours newly reserved promotion claims are held before stale claim expiration sweeps release unpaid order claims (promotion claim hold window, promo reservation TTL, claim expiry).
whyThisDefault: Twenty-four hours preserves the historical reservation hold in commerce_create_promoted_order_draft_with_outbox and matches the default checkout payment and recovery horizon. Interaction: keep promotion_claim_hold_hours aligned with or at least as long as the active checkout.initialPaymentWindow if unpaid checkout recovery should retain reserved promotion capacity until that window closes; shorter holds release abandoned promotion capacity sooner.

effect.appliesTo: New promoted order drafts created via commerce_create_promoted_order_draft_with_outbox record expires_at = now() + make_interval(hours => promotion_claim_hold_hours_read()) on reserved commerce_promotion_claims rows. When no row exists in public.commerce_settings, the SQL reader defaults to 24 hours; malformed rows refuse fail-closed with SQLSTATE 22023 promotion_claim_hold_hours_policy_invalid. Interacts with checkout.initialPaymentWindow: setting holdHours shorter than checkout.initialPaymentWindow can allow stale promotion claim sweeps to cancel unpaid drafts and release claims before checkout recovery completes.
frozenOn: Already reserved, redeemed, or released commerce_promotion_claims rows (including idempotent draft replays) keep their recorded expires_at timestamps.

runtime.reason: Install or update the public.commerce_settings row through installPromotionClaimHoldHoursPolicy or your store deployment step; runtime edits require a write-capable host connection.

rules.description: Supply exactly revision and holdHours. Revision must be a nonblank string and holdHours an integer from 1 through 720.
